title: Anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and protective effects of methanolic extract of Paederia foetida and keracyanin in carrageenan-induced inflammation in rats: Integrated in silico, in vitro and in vivo mechanistic evidence targeting MAPK and NF-kappaB pathways.
authors: Arati, Chettri; Saeed, Ahmed-Laskar; Andy, Lalremruata; Zuali, Lalhmangaih; Abdelmuala Baraka, Abdelgani Gumaa; Atrayee, Borthakur; Lalrinzuali, Sailo; Mimangsha, Chakravarty Dorshon; Shruti, Malik Smita; Chiranjeeb, Rabha; Sonia, Chakma; Khushboo, Maurya; Roy, Vikas Kumar; Gurusubramanian, Guruswami
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物抗炎机制，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-炎症蛋白（iNOS/MAPK/TNF-α），非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Paederia foetida L. is traditionally used in Northeast India and Southeast Asia to treat inflammatory disorders. This study validates its traditional use and bridges ethno-medicinal knowledge with modern pharmacological evidence by providing mechanistic support for the anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities of P. foetida and its bioactive constituent keracyanin. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to evaluate the anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and protective effects of P. foetida extract and its bioactive phytoconstituent, keracyanin, through integrated in silico, in vitro, and in vivo approaches, and to elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms with particular emphasis on the MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Thirty-six polyphenolic compounds previously identified from the methanolic extract of P. foetida (PFME) by HR-LC-MS were retrieved from PubChem and evaluated as phytoligands. Molecular docking and 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations were performed against key inflammatory targets, including iNOS, MAPK, and TNF-alpha. The pharmacokinetic, toxicity, and biological activity profiles of the identified compounds were predicted using ADMET and PASS analyses. Based on the docking and simulation results, keracyanin was selected for further investigation. The in vitro anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities of PFME and keracyanin were assessed using lipoxygenase (LOX), cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), and nitric oxide (NO) inhibition assays, with quercetin and celecoxib as reference compounds. In vivo anti-inflammatory activity was evaluated in a carrageenan-induced paw edema model in Wistar albino rats orally administered PFME (250 and 500 mg/kg) or keracyanin (25 and 50 mg/kg). Paw edema and percentage inhibition were recorded at different time points, and histopathological changes were examined using hematoxylin and eosin staining. Levels of inflammatory mediators, including CRP, NF-kappaB, iNOS, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, p38-MAPK, MPO, COX-2, NO, and PGE2, the anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10, oxidative stress markers (MDA and NO), and antioxidant parameters (TAOC, CAT, SOD, GPx, and GSH), were quantified using ELISA and biochemical assay kits. The expression of TNF-alpha, p38-MAPK, and NF-kappaB signaling proteins was further evaluated by Western blot analysis. Statistical significance was determined using one-way ANOVA followed by Tukey's post hoc test (p < 0.05). RESULTS: Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated that keracyanin exhibited strong and stable interactions with key inflammatory targets, including iNOS, MAPK, and TNF-alpha, showing binding affinities superior to those of the standard inhibitors. PASS prediction suggested a high probability of anti-inflammatory activity, while ADMET analysis indicated favorable pharmacokinetic properties, good drug-likeness, and low toxicity. In vitro studies showed that keracyanin significantly suppressed LOX and COX-2 activities as well as NO production, with efficacy comparable to PFME and greater than that of the reference compounds quercetin and celecoxib. In vivo, PFME (250 and 500 mg/kg) and keracyanin (25 and 50 mg/kg) significantly attenuated carrageenan-induced paw edema in a dose-dependent manner, achieving 53.5-64.2% and 54.5-65.8% inhibition, respectively, at 5 h (p < 0.05), compared with 69.5% inhibition by diclofenac. Histopathological examination confirmed marked protection against carrageenan-induced tissue injury, evidenced by reduced inflammatory cell infiltration, diminished epithelial hyperplasia, minimal edema, and preservation of normal tissue architecture. Furthermore, PFME and keracyanin significantly decreased the levels of inflammatory mediators, while enhancing IL-10 production and restoring antioxidant defenses. These effects were accompanied by reduced lipid peroxidation and significant downregulation of the MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways, as confirmed by ELISA and Western blot analyses. CONCLUSION: The integrated in silico, in vitro, and in vivo findings demonstrate that PFME and its bioactive constituent keracyanin exert potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects through modulation of MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. These results provide mechanistic support for the traditional use of P. foetida in the management of inflammatory disorders and identify keracyanin as a key contributor to its therapeutic activity.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：鸡矢藤（Paederia foetida L.）在印度东北部和东南亚传统上用于治疗炎症性疾病。本研究验证了其传统用途，并通过为鸡矢藤及其生物活性成分花青素苷（keracyanin）的抗炎和抗氧化活性提供机制支持，将民族药物学知识与现代药理学证据联系起来。研究目的：本研究旨在通过整合计算机模拟（in silico）、体外（in vitro）和体内（in vivo）方法，评估鸡矢藤提取物及其生物活性植物成分花青素苷的抗炎、抗氧化和保护作用，并阐明其潜在分子机制，特别关注MAPK和NF-kappaB信号通路。材料与方法：从PubChem数据库中检索了先前通过HR-LC-MS从鸡矢藤甲醇提取物（PFME）中鉴定的36种多酚化合物，并将其作为植物配体进行评估。针对关键炎症靶点（包括iNOS、MAPK和TNF-alpha）进行了分子对接和100 ns分子动力学模拟。使用ADMET和PASS分析预测了所鉴定化合物的药代动力学、毒性和生物活性特征。基于对接和模拟结果，选择花青素苷进行进一步研究。使用脂氧合酶（LOX）、环氧合酶-2（COX-2）和一氧化氮（NO）抑制试验评估了PFME和花青素苷的体外抗炎和抗氧化活性，以槲皮素和塞来昔布作为参考化合物。在Wistar白化大鼠角叉菜胶诱导的爪水肿模型中评估了体内抗炎活性，口服给予PFME（250和500 mg/kg）或花青素苷（25和50 mg/kg）。在不同时间点记录爪水肿和抑制百分比，并使用苏木精-伊红染色检查组织病理学变化。使用ELISA和生化检测试剂盒定量了炎症介质水平，包括CRP、NF-kappaB、iNOS、TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6、p38-MAPK、MPO、COX-2、NO和PGE2，抗炎细胞因子IL-10，氧化应激标志物（MDA和NO），以及抗氧化参数（TAOC、CAT、SOD、GPx和GSH）。通过Western blot分析进一步评估了TNF-alpha、p38-MAPK和NF-kappaB信号蛋白的表达。使用单因素方差分析（one-way ANOVA）后进行Tukey事后检验确定统计学显著性（p < 0.05）。结果：分子对接和分子动力学模拟表明，花青素苷与关键炎症靶点（包括iNOS、MAPK和TNF-alpha）表现出强且稳定的相互作用，其结合亲和力优于标准抑制剂。PASS预测提示其具有高概率的抗炎活性，而ADMET分析表明其具有有利的药代动力学特性、良好的类药性和低毒性。体外研究表明，花青素苷显著抑制LOX和COX-2活性以及NO产生，其功效与PFME相当，且优于参考化合物槲皮素和塞来昔布。在体内，PFME（250和500 mg/kg）和花青素苷（25和50 mg/kg）以剂量依赖性方式显著减轻角叉菜胶诱导的爪水肿，在5小时时分别达到53.5-64.2%和54.5-65.8%的抑制率（p < 0.05），而双氯芬酸的抑制率为69.5%。组织病理学检查证实对角叉菜胶诱导的组织损伤具有显著保护作用，表现为炎症细胞浸润减少、上皮增生减轻、水肿最小化以及正常组织结构的保留。此外，PFME和花青素苷显著降低炎症介质水平，同时增强IL-10产生并恢复抗氧化防御。这些效应伴随脂质过氧化减少以及MAPK和NF-kappaB信号通路的显著下调，经ELISA和Western blot分析证实。结论：综合计算机模拟、体外和体内研究结果表明，PFME及其生物活性成分花青素苷通过调节MAPK和NF-kappaB信号通路发挥强效抗炎和抗氧化作用。这些结果为鸡矢藤在炎症性疾病管理中的传统用途提供了机制支持，并确定花青素苷是其治疗活性的关键贡献者。
